description: Making AI Work: The government approved an MoU to enhance public infrastructure planning and project supervision using AI tools. A new expressway project connecting Buxar and Bhagalpur received cabinet approval for implementation.
body_lead: Bihar govt to sign MoU with Taiyo to boost state's AI ecosystem The government approved an MoU to enhance public infrastructure planning and project supervision using AI tools. A new expressway project connecting Buxar and Bhagalpur received cabinet approval for implementation. The Bihar government has decided to sign an MoU with Taiyo AI India Pvt Ltd to promote the development of an artificial intelligence ecosystem in the state.
